gloss: Pair the authority to repair harm with involving those harmed in defining the repair
mechanism: When harm is acknowledged, the party holding {{responsibility}} for repair involves those harmed in defining what repair means, records their definition, and reports what was done against it.
invariants: Those harmed take part in defining the repair.
What was done is reported against the defined repair.
failure_modes: Unilateral repair: the harming party alone decides what counts as repair.
Endless repair: repair is never declared complete.
